title: add-benchmark-lab-mixed-workload-reporting-pipeline-v109
author: Priya Shah
description: Add mixed-workload reporting pipeline v109: This PR wires up the next iteration of the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline to support mixed workload runners and updated profiling baselines. Motivation: we observed increased variance in tail latency for mixed CPU/GPU workloads during the v108 pilot; this change standardizes the reporting schema, aggregates per-run KV cache metrics, and adds a lightweight postprocessing step that computes weighted percentiles for mixed-run summaries. Main changes: 1) New airflow DAG (benchlab_mixed_reporting_v109) that coordinates workload runners, profiling baselines ingestion, and reporting. 2) Reporting microservice changes: new endpoints for mixed-run summary, added KV cache histogram ingestion, and consolidated tags for model-variant routing. 3) Representative workload runners: added a mixed_cpu_gpu runner that orchestrates synthetic traffic patterns used during the profiling runs. 4) Profiling baselines: updated baseline payload schema and added stability checks to drop noisy runs. 5) CI/telemetry: added end-to-end integration test and dashboards. Migration notes: the DAG supports backfill of the last 7 days; existing v108 reports remain compatible via the compatibility layer. Rollout plan: deploy to staging, run a two-day comparative run against v108, validate percentiles and KV cache metrics, then promote to prod. Related: ENG-3812 (mixed-workload telemetry), PM-112 (benchmark lab roadmap).
